server.description: Proton Mail MCP via Bridge (IMAP/SMTP) · 13 tools · dual transport stdio + HTTP.

environmentVariables.description: Hostname or IP of the Proton Mail Bridge (default: 127.0.0.1 for local, or container hostname in compose).
environmentVariables.name: PROTON_BRIDGE_HOST

environmentVariables.description: IMAP port exposed by Proton Mail Bridge (default: 1143).
environmentVariables.name: PROTON_IMAP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: SMTP port exposed by Proton Mail Bridge (default: 1025).
environmentVariables.name: PROTON_SMTP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Bridge username (your Proton Mail address).
environmentVariables.name: PROTON_USERNAME

environmentVariables.description: Bridge-generated app password (NOT your Proton account password).
environmentVariables.name: PROTON_PASSWORD

server.name: io.github.AlexikM/gibil
server.description: Spawns an ephemeral Ubuntu VM with project clone, shell exec, file I/O, and auto-destroy on TTL.

environmentVariables.description: Required when targeting Hetzner. Get from console.hetzner.com > Security > API Tokens.
environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_API_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Required when targeting Vultr. Get from my.vultr.com > Account > API. At least one provider token is required.
environmentVariables.name: VULTR_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Used to clone private GitHub repos into the VM at boot via cloud-init.
environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Authenticates against gibil.dev for usage tracking and paid plans.
environmentVariables.name: GIBIL_API_KEY
